### Child Restraint in Front
`porsche_taycan_en_df56b6fe` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
Seat
The use of a child restraint system in the front passenger seat can result in serious personal injury or
death to the child from an airbag deployment.
To reduce risk of injury from an inflating airbag in an
accident, Porsche strongly recommends:
e
Under all normal circumstances, the child seat
must be placed in the rear.
Do not use a child restraint system on the front
passenger seat.
>

### Please see chapter "Automatic locking retractor"
`porsche_taycan_en_da5195b0` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
on page 97.
However, there may be serious situations where it
might be necessary to place a child in the front seat
so that he/she can be kept under direct observation
to prevent an immediate risk to the child (for example, while driving to the doctor or hospital).

### Seek appropriate advice from your authorized
`porsche_taycan_en_4e92580d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
Porsche dealer about the possible installation of
a Porsche child restraint system.
e
If a child restraint system must be fastened to
the front passenger seat, adjust the seat as far
away from the airbag as possible and adjust the
passenger seat backrest angle to ensure firm
contact between the passenger seat and the
child restraint system.
e

### If emergency or other serious conditions require
`porsche_taycan_en_70e90641` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:99
a child to be placed in the front seat, exercise
extreme caution and defensive driving of your
vehicle.

### Child restraint system for up to one-year old
`porsche_taycan_en_08212ed4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
children
If the child restraint system must be fastened to the
passenger’s seat in exceptional cases:
e
When an up to one-year old child is seated in the
child restraint system, the front airbag is automatically deactivated on the passenger side.
e

### Make sure that the PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF
`porsche_taycan_en_599b493a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
indicator light lights up.
e
Adjust the passenger’s seat as far away from the
airbag and adjacent car body parts as possible.
DANGER

### Child Seat Detection
`porsche_taycan_en_447edee7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
Fault
When the ignition is on and the up to one-year old
child is seated in the child restraint system on the
passenger seat the indicator light PASSENGER AIR
BAG OFF must be on.
If the PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF indicator light does
not light up, it could indicate a fault in the system,
and the airbag could inflate in a collision, placing the
child at risk of death or severe injury from the inflating airbag.

### In this case:
`porsche_taycan_en_0da63eab` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:99
e
Install child restraint system on the rear seats.

`porsche_taycan_en_8ce1cd7c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:99
Your vehicle is equipped with capacitance occupant
sensing for the passenger's seat in accordance with
U.S. Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard 208.

### Depending on the electrical capacitance acting on
`porsche_taycan_en_3307d0a5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:99
the passenger's seat, the passenger's airbag will automatically be switched on or off.

Some smaller adults may not trigger the PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF indicator light to be turned off. If
the light is lit when an adult occupies the seat, they
should reposition their body properly, centered in the
seat with feet on the floor and not leaning on adjacent body parts. If the lamp still does not turn off,
the person should move to a rear seat for better
protection, and the vehicle should be taken to an
authorized Porsche dealer for evaluation.

### Swallowing Engine
`porsche_taycan_en_92ba0b33` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:102
Coolant
Engine coolant is hazardous to your health and may
be fatal if swallowed.
e
Keep engine coolant out of children's reach.
e

### Keep engine coolant away from pets. They can
`porsche_taycan_en_201cb13a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:102
be attracted to it should there be a spill, or to
used engine coolant left in an open container.
e
If engine coolant gets on your skin or into your
eye, immediately rinse the affected party of your
body with clean water for a few minutes. Then
see a doctor immediately.
e
Note all the information on the refill container of
the engine coolant.
WARNING

### Coolant reservoir
`porsche_taycan_en_0af2afed` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:102
The coolant reservoir is pressurized and contains hot
coolant. Coolant can suddenly spray out when you
open the coolant reservoir.
e
Never open the cap of the coolant reservoir. Visit
an authorized Porsche dealer. Porsche recommends an authorized Porsche dealer, as they
have trained technicians and the necessary parts
and tools.
e
Take care when working near hot vehicle parts.
NOTICE
If you continue to drive the vehicle when a warning
light is on, you risk damaging the vehicle.
e
Park the vehicle and leave it to cool down.
e

### Have the fault corrected immediately. Visit an
`porsche_taycan_en_ab9825b2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:102
authorized Porsche dealer. Porsche recommends
an authorized Porsche dealer, as they have
trained technicians and the necessary parts and
tools.
NOTICE
If the coolant level drops, this is an indication of a
fault on the vehicle, e.g. leaks in the cooling system.
e
Never add coolant yourself.
e

### Have the cause corrected immediately. Visit an
`porsche_taycan_en_5be1c364` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:102
authorized Porsche dealer. Porsche recommends
an authorized Porsche dealer, as they have
trained technicians and the necessary parts and
tools.

freeze protection to –35 °F / –37 °C. The coolant
level is regularly checked as part of servicing.
e
Porsche recommends Glysantin® G40® (alternatively freeze protection agents in accordance
with G12++/VW TL 774 G).
e

ommends an authorized Porsche dealer, as they
have trained technicians and the necessary parts

### Unsafe traffic situation
`porsche_taycan_en_eb74e315` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:103
and unfavorable road
conditions
Using cruise control can lead to an accident if the
prevailing traffic situation does not allow you to drive
at a sufficient distance to the car in front and at a
constant speed.
e
Do not use cruise control in heavy traffic, on
windy stretches of road or in unfavorable road
conditions (e.g. wintery conditions, wet roads,
varying road surfaces).

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_565e4675` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:103
Cruise control maintains the chosen speed in the
range between approx. 20 mph and 150 mph (30
km/h and 240 km/h) without the driver having to
press the accelerator pedal.
Controls

### Cruise control is passive. Control is
`porsche_taycan_en_d8a2a4fa` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:103

still displayed.

`porsche_taycan_en_ed58f426` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:103
switched on. The system is initially in passive mode
when switched on. It must first be activated before
the control function starts working.

`porsche_taycan_en_8c0ded28` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:103
Cruise control using the rotary push button on
the steering wheel and press to confirm.
Cruise control is switched on and passive.

### Emergency Call Systems
`porsche_taycan_en_08223153` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:110
Different emergency call systems may be used depending on model, country and equipment. Help can
be requested via the emergency call system in an
emergency or in dangerous situations.
Despite activated private mode, location information
for the vehicle can be transmitted in the event of a
breakdown or emergency call as well as theft.

### Emergency call
`porsche_taycan_en_104b1880` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:110
b Cellphone network available.
b Emergency call system ready for operation
(about 20 seconds after vehicle is switched on).
Information
The emergency call system does not require a cellphone registered in the vehicle as it has its own
cellphone module.
Under unfavorable conditions, an emergency call to
an emergency call center cannot be ensured (e.g. no
cellphone network available).

### Due to technical or organizational restrictions be-
`porsche_taycan_en_45ecef7d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:110
yond the control of Porsche (e.g. vehicle is in a location where there is no emergency call system
coverage), it may not always be possible to establish
an emergency call to the relevant emergency call
center. If legally permitted, an emergency call can be
established to a public emergency call center in this
case. A public emergency call center may not be able
to process the data transmitted by the emergency
call system for determination of the necessary rescue measures (e.g. the current position of the vehicle
is not sent automatically).
If the vehicle battery is disconnected or defective, an
integral battery ensures that the emergency call
system remains available for at least one hour for
queries from the emergency call center.
Information
When the cover is open, the SOS button can be accidentally pressed and therefore trigger an unintentional emergency call.
e

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_fc0f78dd` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:113
In the following situation, this function can be
limited, may not react or automatically deactivate:
–
The driver actuates the accelerator pedal, the
brake or the steering wheel.
–
The driving system such as Lane Keep Assist,
Active Lane Keeping, Adaptive Cruise Control
(ACC) or Porsche InnoDrive (PID) are accessible
on a limited basis.
–
In case of damage or soiling of the radar sensors
or the front windshield in the area of the camera.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_51231c92` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:113
The system monitors the driver's steering, accelerator pedal and brake pedal activity and provides assistance in the speed range from 0 mph (0 km/h) to
approx. 130 mph (210 km/h) –
155 mph (250 km/h)1.
When the emergency stop function is activated, it
initiates visual, acoustic or tactile warnings in stages
and brakes the vehicle to a standstill.
The following conditions must be met so that the
switched-on emergency stop function can be
activated:
In the speed range from 0 mph (0 km/h) to
40 mph (65 km/h):
–
Active Lane Keeping is active and the driver does
not react to the takeover prompts from Active
Lane Keeping.
In the speed range from 40 mph (65 km/h) to
130 mph (210 km/h):
–
Active Lane Keeping is active and the driver does
not react to the takeover prompts from Active
Lane Keeping.
–
Active Lane Keeping is switched off, Lane Keep
Assist is active and the driver does not react to
the takeover prompts from Lane Keep Assist.
–
Active Lane Keeping is switched off, Lane Keep

### Assist is switched off and the emergency stop
`porsche_taycan_en_caa55351` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:113
function does not detect any steering, brake
pedal or accelerator pedal activity.
In the speed range from 130 mph (210 km/h) to
approx. 156 mph (250 km/h):
–
Lane Keep Assist is active and the driver does not
react to the takeover prompts from Lane Keep
Assist.
–
Lane Keep Assist is switched off and the emergency stop function does not detect any steering, brake pedal or accelerator pedal activity.
The emergency stop function is not available if Active Lane Keeping is switched off in the speed range
below 40 mph (65 km/h).
These warnings prompt the driver to take over control of the vehicle:
–

### Indicator on the door mirror
`porsche_taycan_en_ec0b953c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:115
B
Indicator in the door panel.
When the door is opened or if the door is already
open, the indicators in the door mirror on the relevant side of the vehicle and in the door panel on the
relevant door light up to indicate that road users are
approaching.
If a vehicle occupant attempts to open a door while
an approaching road user is detected as a hazard, the
door will be momentarily prevented from opening.
Indicators A in the door mirror and B in the door
panel will flash briefly.
If an approaching road user is detected as a hazard
when the door is already open, indicators A and B will
light up until the danger has passed.

### Sealing defective tires
`porsche_taycan_en_c03c7b13` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:116
b Vehicles with tire sealant (Tire Mobility System
–TMS).
WARNING

### Risk of accident due to
`porsche_taycan_en_44d9eda1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:116
sealed tires
Damaged tires that are sealed with tire sealant can
lose pressure or burst in the event of inappropriate
speed or continuous loading.
e
Sealing the tire with the tire sealant is only an
emergency solution enabling you to drive to the
nearest authorized Porsche dealer.
e
Use the tire sealant only in the case of cuts or
punctures no larger than 0.16 in. (4 mm).
e
Never use tire sealant if the rim is damaged or if
you have driven with low tire pressure or deflated
tires.
e

### Avoid rapid acceleration and high cornering

for use in the separate operating instructions for

### The sealant is highly flammable and harmful to
`porsche_taycan_en_9d7bc75e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:116
health. Prolonged or repeated exposure can cause
irritation, allergic reaction or organ damage.
e
Fire, naked flames and smoking are prohibited
when handling tire sealant.
e
Keep tire sealant away from children.
e
Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothing.
e
If tire sealant gets on your skin or into your eyes,
thoroughly rinse the affected part of your body
immediately with plenty of water.
e
If you feel unwell or have an allergic reaction,
consult a doctor immediately.
e
Change soiled clothing immediately.
e
Do not inhale vapors.
e
If tire sealant is swallowed, thoroughly rinse out
your mouth immediately and drink plenty of
water. Do not induce vomiting. Consult a doctor
immediately.

### Loss of control over the
`porsche_taycan_en_4620880a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:125
vehicle
Despite the HOLD function, responsibility for stopping and starting on gradients lies with the driver.
When stopping and starting on slippery surfaces (e.
g. icy or loose substrate) the HOLD function cannot
be guaranteed to provide assistance. The vehicle can
roll away.
e
Always adjust your driving style to the road surface and the vehicle load; use the footbrake if
necessary.
If the HOLD function is not working, the driver
cannot be assisted when driving off on gradients.

### Slight rolling back on
`porsche_taycan_en_abe66952` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:125
uphill slopes
If the vehicle comes to a standstill on steep gradients without the driver applying the footbrake, the
vehicle can roll back until the HOLD function stops it.
In this situation it is possible to reduce the roll-back
by applying the footbrake.
e

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_9f348069` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:125
The HOLD function assists the driver when stopping
the vehicle and driving off on steep gradients. The
vehicle is automatically secured against rolling back
opposite the desired direction of travel.
When the HOLD function is active, the light indicator
on the instrument cluster comes on.
When Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) is operating
normally, the HOLD function actively holds the vehicle at a standstill following automatic braking.
If the driver seat belt is unfastened and the driver
door is opened while the HOLD function is active, the
parking lock and parking brake are activated
automatically.
If the vehicle is held on a steep gradient, you can
drive off in the usual way.

### Activating the HOLD function
`porsche_taycan_en_f9880d87` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:125
b Drive position D or R selected.
e
Press the brake pedal until the vehicle comes to
a standstill.
The HOLD function is activated. The vehicle is held
stationary even without pressing the brake pedal.
Information
The HOLD function can also be activated, irrespective of the gradient, by quickly flooring the pressed
brake pedal while the vehicle is stationary. Changing
the drive position will not deactivate the HOLD
function in this case.
Information
When the HOLD function is active, the driver may
feel a difference in the brake pedal, and hydraulic
noises may be heard.
This behavior is typical of the system. There is no
fault.

### Unsecured Luggage
`porsche_taycan_en_89e947f7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:127
Compartment Lid
If the luggage compartment lid is not secured properly, it could fly up, blocking your vision and causing
loss of control.
e
Should you notice at any time while driving that
the lid is not secured properly, stop immediately
in a suitable place and close it.

### Trunk entrapment
`porsche_taycan_en_a547ba77` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:127
Your vehicle is equipped with an internal trunk release mechanism.

`porsche_taycan_en_4a9b70f8` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:127
release the lid from the inside using the unlocking
button.
The unlocking button is equipped with a light indicator. The light indicator keeps flashing for 60 minutes after locking the luggage compartment lid.
WARNING

`porsche_taycan_en_545dd524` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:127
When loading the luggage compartment, make sure
that items of luggage or other objects cannot become caught on the button. This could cause the
luggage compartment to open unintentionally.
Function
If the luggage compartment lid is unlocked by using
the internal trunk release mechanism, the latch
striker pops into the catch-hook position and the lid
can be opened from the inside immediately.

`porsche_taycan_en_7bba052b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:141

include:

### Vehicles approaching very fast or very slowly
`porsche_taycan_en_0ce7c56d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:141
may not always be detected in time.
–

### Crossing objects that accelerate or change driv-
`porsche_taycan_en_88e58032` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:141
ing behavior (e.g. sudden turn-offs) can cause
incorrect warnings or prevent warnings from
being issued.
–
When turning off, if the vehicle is not facing in
the direction of the driving lane (but is inclined
diagonally, at a right angle to it or sharply upward
or downward), approaching vehicles may not be
detected or may not be detected in time.
–
When your vehicle accelerates from a stillstand,
the system may not detect a turn-off or may only
detect a turn-off after a delay under certain circumstances. The system may assume you are
driving straight on and generate a false collision
warning.
e
Drive with extreme care.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_755e60e3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:141
Intersection Assist monitors the areas around the
front and sides of the vehicle at intersections and
exits. The areas are monitored by the camera and
radar sensors integrated in the vehicle.
In the event of a possible collision, the system warns
the driver by means of visual and acoustic signals on
the instrument cluster and central display and by
initiating a brief warning jolt if necessary.

the driver by issuing a warning tone and displaying a
collision warning.
In another display, red arrows also indicate the direction from which the cross traffic is approaching.
–
This is indicated in the central display only when
ParkAssist is activated.
–

### Lane Change Assist only alerts you to approach-
`porsche_taycan_en_fe498aca` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:144
ing vehicles or vehicles in the blind spot above a
driving speed of approx. 9 mph (15 km/h).
–

### Vehicles that approach at high speed from be-
`porsche_taycan_en_9a2a6f00` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:144
hind or vehicles that are falling back.
–
If the vehicle is not facing in the direction of the
driving lane when turning but is facing diagonally
or at right angles to it, approaching vehicles can
no longer be detected by the radar sensors.
–
In the case of Rear Turn Assist, it is possible that,
owing to the small differences in speed between
your vehicle and moving or stationary objects,
fixed objects (e.g. a metal post) may also trigger
a warning or that slow-moving vehicles will not
be detected.
–
Rear Turn Assist is activated when driving off. It
may therefore occur that vehicles that are already moving or are driving off will not be detected or will only be detected late. Vehicles
already located immediately next to your vehicle
and therefore outside of the detection range of
the sensor may not be detected either.
–

around the vehicle in view at all times.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_b6c874e2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:145
–
Only Rear Turn Assist is available at speeds below 9 mph (15 km/h). When driving off, the
driver is therefore only supported by monitoring
of the area behind the vehicle on the side of the
vehicle on which the direction indicator was
actuated.
–
Lane Change Assist and Rear Turn Assist are not
available if the system detects that the radar
sensors are covered.
–
The rear collision warning may be switched off if
there is a malfunction in the Lane Change Assist.
–
The radar sensors cover the adjacent lane to the
left and right. Other lanes are not covered by the
radar sensors.
–

### The radar sensors can sometimes detect other
`porsche_taycan_en_c91166ea` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:145
objects (e.g. high or raised crash barriers), not
only vehicles.
Information
If the position of the radar sensors was changed following an accident, for example, this can impair the
function of Lane Change Assist.
e

### To ensure that Lane Change Assist operates
`porsche_taycan_en_40b652e9` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:145
correctly:
e
Do not cover the radar sensors on the rear
bumper (e.g. with stickers). Keep the area clean
and free of snow and ice.
e
Do not cover the warning indicator in the exterior
mirror (e.g. with stickers).
e
Subsequent painting of the bumper may lead to a
reduction in the sensor range owing to the
thicker coating layer. The electrical properties
may also differ from those of the approved
paints.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_f3001561` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:145
Lane Change Assist (LCA) warns the driver about
vehicles that are approaching from the rear or are
located in the blind spot. This applies both when
overtaking other vehicles and when your vehicle is
being overtaken.

### Using the radar sensors integrated in the rear
`porsche_taycan_en_6b8c2592` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:145
bumper, Lane Change Assist measures the distance
and speed difference of the detected vehicles in relation to your vehicle. The radar sensors cover an
area of up to 230 ft. (70 m) to the rear and the blind
spot area.
As soon as the direction indicator is activated for a
lane change regarded as critical, the warning indicator in the respective exterior mirror lights up brightly
and briefly several times. The system therefore provides assistance separately for both sides of the
vehicle.
When slowly overtaking another vehicle (speed difference of less than approx. 9 mph (15 km/h)), the
warning indicator lights up as soon as this vehicle is
in your blind spot area and is detected by Lane
Change Assist. If the speed difference is greater, no
warning indicator will be activated on the door
mirror.

### The rear turn assist is always automatically activated
`porsche_taycan_en_38fed05c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:145
together with the Lane Change Assist. The driver is
supported by Rear Turn Assist until the Lane Change
Assist speed range is reached after driving off.
When the turn signal is on, the Rear Turn Assist detects objects located next to and behind your vehicle, but only at the side on which the turn signal
has been activated. If a potential hazard is detected,
the respective warning indicator on the door mirror
lights up. If your own calculated driving path crosses
that of a detected vehicle on the side of the vehicle
on which the turn signal has been activated, the respective warning indicator on the door mirror will
flash brightly and briefly several times.

### Rear collision warning
`porsche_taycan_en_b76a0631` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:146
If the radar sensors in the rear of the vehicle detect
vehicles traveling behind, the system calculates the
probability of a rear-end collision.
If a collision risk is detected, the emergency flasher
comes on to alert the driver in the vehicle traveling
behind to the imminent danger situation.
In this case, the emergency flasher could flash faster
than it normally would when switched on manually.

### Display elements
`porsche_taycan_en_03f5fb69` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:146
Lane Change Assist provides information using two
indicator stages - an information stage and a warning stage - which are activated as appropriate, depending on whether or not the turn signal was set.

### Information stage

### Obscured camera view
`porsche_taycan_en_71d07590` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:149
The camera's view can be impaired by different influencing factors (e.g. rain, snow, ice, heavy water
spray, oncoming headlights or damage). Sometimes,
the camera cannot detect the lane markings, or
cannot detect them correctly. When this happens,
no steering intervention or an unexpected steering
intervention can occur. Steering intervention can
only take place on the side where a lane marking has
been detected. Other road structures or objects may
be incorrectly identified as lane markings as well.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_f7af2166` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:150
Fig. 94: Windshield camera
Lane Keep Assist helps the driver keep the vehicle in
the lane. The system uses the front camera (A) to
detect the course of the road ahead based on the
lane markings and initiates corrective steering intervention when the vehicle approaches a detected lane
marking and is in danger of leaving the driving lane.
However, the driver can override this steering intervention at any time.
If the vehicle crosses a lane marking without activating a turn signal, the system can alert the driver
acoustically. The acoustic warning must be switched
on in the central display for this to happen. If the
vehicle crosses a lane marking after the driver has
activated a turn signal, the system does not issue a
warning or steer because the lane change is interpreted as intentional in this case.
The system is designed for driving on highways and
well-surfaced country roads in a speed range of approx. 40 mph – 156 mph (65 km/h – 250 km/h).

### Vehicles with Lane Change Assist
`porsche_taycan_en_acec8458` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:150
If the vehicle is equipped with Lane Change Assist,
the active system warns the driver through corrective steering intervention when changing lanes in a
potentially critical situation. Steering intervention
occurs even if the turn signal is activated for the direction in question. If the steering intervention is
overridden by the driver, an additional warning is
provided via a warning tone (if active).

### Behavior if there is no steering activity
`porsche_taycan_en_7df1a867` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:150
The driver's steering behavior is monitored when
Lane Keep Assist is switched on and active. If there
is no steering activity (e.g. hands not on the steering
wheel or only resting lightly), a warning appears in
the instrument cluster. The system prompts the
driver to actively take over the steering. If the driver
does not react to the takeover prompt, the system
switches to a passive state.

`porsche_taycan_en_b7306086` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:154
Fig. 97: Windshield camera

high beam illumination. The level of light is chosen
so that the light/dark threshold of the driving lights
reaches to the nearest vehicle detected.

### Lack of attention and
`porsche_taycan_en_0dd54f64` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:164
failure to detect objects
via Night View Assist
Night View Assist is a support system and cannot
alert the driver of a collision under all circumstances.
There is a risk of accident.

### Responsibility for braking in time and for appropriate
`porsche_taycan_en_cfe2d689` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:164
vehicle lighting always lies with the driver.
e
Drive with extreme care.
e

### Night View Assist un-
`porsche_taycan_en_f3aea176` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:164
available or only available
to a limited extent
Shocks or damage to the bumper, e.g. through
parking collisions, can displace the camera. This may
impair the performance of the system.
e

### The assistance provided by the system cannot be
`porsche_taycan_en_1db3ec66` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:164
guaranteed in certain situations. Such situations
include:
–
It will not always be possible to detect pedestrians and animals.
–
Adverse weather conditions, such as heavy rain,
snowfall and ice formation, can impair operation
of the camera as well as detection of collision
hazards.
–
In complex driving situations, the pedestrian and
animal warning system can trigger unintentional
warnings owing to internal limitations of the
system.
e

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_e8301174` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:164
The thermal imaging camera in the front bumper
provides a differential thermal image of the surrounding area that can be displayed on the instrument cluster. The system can detect persons and
animals beyond the area illuminated by the headlights and highlight them in the camera image.

### Night View Assist detects persons and animals when
`porsche_taycan_en_4b4a2744` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:164
it is sufficiently dark and at an ambient temperature
below 82 °F (28 °C) in a vehicle speed range up to
156 mph (250 km/h).

### Pedestrian warning
`porsche_taycan_en_29fb912a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:164
If the system detects a potential collision with a pedestrian, it can warn the driver with a warning tone
and a display on the instrument cluster. The camera
image is displayed with the person marked in red.
A pedestrian warning is emitted if a pedestrian is
standing in or moving into the driving lane.
In vehicles with LED matrix headlights, the headlights flash at the endangered person in order to enhance detection. Even with this warning, the driver
may still have to swerve or brake sharply in order to
avoid a collision. The warning time varies according
to the traffic situation and the driver's behavior.

### Animal warning
`porsche_taycan_en_f07ccccb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:164
If the system detects a potential collision with large
wildlife outside urban areas, e.g. deer, it can warn the
driver with a warning tone and a display on the instrument cluster. At the same time, the camera image appears with the animal marked in red.
The animal warning is triggered if an animal is located in the driving lane or is in close proximity.

### The animal warning is deactivated automatically in
`porsche_taycan_en_3c4775b1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:164
urban areas in order to prevent it from being triggered by leashed dogs, for example.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_4ebd6a23` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:166
The system cannot detect the following:
–
Sound-absorbing obstacles (e.g. wintery conditions, powder snow, clothing made from fabric,
hide or fur).
–
Sound-reflecting obstacles (e.g. glass surfaces,
flat enameled surfaces).
–
Very thin obstacles (e.g. thin posts).
–
External ultrasound waves (e.g. air brakes from
other vehicles, road sweeping machines, pneumatic hammers) can interfere with obstacle
detection.
–
Obstacles, if the sensors or cameras are very
dirty or covered, e.g. by dust, dirt, snow or ice.

### ParkAssist visually and audibly indicates to the driver
`porsche_taycan_en_046cac59` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:166

during parking and maneuvering.

`porsche_taycan_en_5cc5e246` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:166

behind the vehicle are indicated by means of different colored fields on the display. These fields show
the contour of the obstacles as well as their distance
from the vehicle.

### Distance measurement
`porsche_taycan_en_46862bc1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:166
Fig. 114: Ultrasound sensors for distance measurement
The ultrasound sensors A in the front and rear
bumpers measure the distance to the nearest obstacle. A detected obstacle is reported by an intermittent tone. The intervals shorten as the vehicle
approaches the obstacle. When the distance is less
than approx. 12 in. (30 cm), a continuous tone
sounds.

### Obstacles above and below the sensors cannot be
`porsche_taycan_en_61ef6e1b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:166
detected.
You can adjust the volume of the warning tones in
the central display.

### Personal settings
`porsche_taycan_en_728f5c6c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:170
Ergonomic settings can be stored and retrieved
manually using the memory buttons in the driver's
door. In addition, individual accounts that automatically store and retrieve ergonomic and comfort settings can be registered via the central display. Both
functions can be used independently of one another.

### Storing and retrieving personal
`porsche_taycan_en_0f08ec47` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:170
settings
If the vehicle is switched off, the previously actuated
settings are automatically stored in the selected account and paired with the vehicle key used. The settings are loaded automatically when the door is
unlocked, when the account paired with the vehicle
key is detected. If two or more people use the vehicle, the use of one account and one vehicle key per
person is recommended. The accounts can be
changed manually if required.

### Ergonomic settings affect:
`porsche_taycan_en_0b8d3d21` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:170
seat, door mirror and steering wheel settings.
In addition, up to three ergonomic settings can be
manually stored and retrieved via the memory buttons in the driver's door.
Comfort settings (depending on the country) affect:
ergonomic, air conditioning, light, vision, assistance
system, instrument cluster and infotainment
settings.
Information
Some functions cannot be personalized (e.g. the
charge timer, time zones and parking preclimatization).
CAUTION

### Retrieving automatic
`porsche_taycan_en_709a95d0` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:170
seat, door mirror, and
steering wheel settings
Parts of the body may be pinched or crushed if the
settings are activated in an uncontrolled manner.

### Lack of attention
`porsche_taycan_en_efa3a5ec` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:183
The system must not induce you to take risks with
your safety. The driver remains responsible when
driving, such as by keeping a safe distance or driving
at an appropriate speed, even when the system is
activated. The system is no substitute for the driver's attentiveness.
e
Drive with extreme care.
e

### If the system-induced deceleration is insuffi-
`porsche_taycan_en_ed135382` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:183
cient, slow the vehicle down immediately using
the footbrake.
e
Make sure that you can take control of the vehicle at any time.
WARNING

### Unsafe traffic situation
`porsche_taycan_en_acf2626c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:183
and unfavorable road
conditions
If the prevailing situation does not allow you to drive
safely at a sufficient distance and constant speed,
using the system can cause accidents.

### The system assists the driver when making turns
`porsche_taycan_en_6a0339a2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:183
and taking exits. Especially unfavorable conditions
can therefore lead to undesired driving situations.
The vehicle can accelerate to the set speed when
driving in areas with road construction.
e
Do not use the system in heavy traffic, where
there is road construction and in built-up areas.
e

### When making turns and taking exits with the
`porsche_taycan_en_8eaee8c6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:183
system activated, use the turn signal in a timely
manner, be especially careful and take over control of the vehicle if needed.
WARNING

### Partially or completely
`porsche_taycan_en_23fd5f5f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:183
covered front camera or
radar sensor and poor
ambient conditions
Radar sensor and camera vision can be impaired by
rain, snow, ice, fog, loose gravel and spray. Vehicles
in front may not be adequately detected, or may not
be detected at all.
Reflective objects such as ice, heavy rain, crash barriers or tunnel entrances may impair the functionality of the radar sensor. A message indicating that the
system is not available appears on the instrument
cluster.
e
Do not use the system under such conditions.
e
Always keep the radar sensor and camera area A
on the rearview mirror free of dirt, ice and snow.
e
Do not cover the camera area on the rearview
mirror A with objects (e.g. stickers).

### This equipment complies with the specified FCC ra-
`porsche_taycan_en_bb644e53` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:183
diation exposure limits for an uncontrolled environment. This equipment should be installed and
operated with minimum distance of 8 in. (20 cm)

### Damage to the radar
`porsche_taycan_en_c3dc1ece` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:184
sensor and camera
Shocks or damage to the bumper, wheel housings or
underbody, such as through parking collisions, can
displace the sensors. Stone damage in the area of

camera view. This can adversely affect the system.
e

### Go to an qualified specialized repair shop. Por-

sche recommends an authorized Porsche dealer,
as they have trained technicians and the necessary parts and tools.

and taking exits. Particularly unfavorable conditions
can therefore lead to undesired driving situations.

over control of the vehicle if necessary.

### Driving in areas with
`porsche_taycan_en_faa555ff` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:184
roadworks
The vehicle can accelerate to the set speed when
driving in areas with roadworks.
e

### Foot on the accelerator
`porsche_taycan_en_5adcbd3f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:184
The system does not brake automatically when your
foot is on the accelerator pedal. Placing the foot on
the accelerator pedal may override the cruise and
distance control.
e
Take your foot off the accelerator pedal when the
system is activated.
WARNING

### The system assists the driver when approaching
`porsche_taycan_en_b4b11d04` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:184
Stop and Yield signs as long as these traffic signs are
stored in the navigation data. The vehicle will only be
slowed but not be braked to a standstill.
e
When approaching a Stop sign and if required by
the traffic situation, brake the vehicle independently to a standstill when approaching a Yield
sign.
WARNING

### Recognizing traffic lights
`porsche_taycan_en_ac8e5016` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:184
The system does not recognize traffic lights.
e
Take over control of the vehicle at traffic lights
that require braking and stopping of the vehicle.
WARNING

### Inadequate braking
`porsche_taycan_en_36697d10` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:184
power during automatic
braking
If the system detects that braking assistance is required on the part of the driver, a warning tone
sounds and a warning message appears on the instrument cluster. In this case, the system braking
power will be insufficient to prevent a collision.
e
Brake immediately in such cases.
e
Make sure that you can take control of the vehicle at any time.
Information

### Porsche InnoDrive offers assisted driving. It is the
`porsche_taycan_en_5b692954` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:184
responsibility of the driver at all times to monitor the
system, assess the traffic situation and intervene if
necessary. In some cases, the system automatically
determines that driver intervention is necessary. In
such cases, an appropriate message appears in the
instrument cluster.

### The system is switched off in the following
`porsche_taycan_en_ecd659bb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:184
situations:
–
PSM is deactivated.
–
The driver’s door is opened.
–
The driver’s seat belt is open.
–
Transmission range N or R is selected.
–
The parking lock or parking brake is activated.
–
When driving on private lanes, field tracks or in
traffic-calmed streets (e.g. play streets).
–
In a vehicle position that cannot be clearly recognized by the system.
–
In a country that is not enabled.
–
With a speed limit below 20 mph (30 km/h).
e
Take over control of the vehicle if necessary.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_54afc012` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:186
Porsche InnoDrive (PID) is a driver assistance system that assists the driver when driving on wellsurfaced country roads and highways.
Using navigation data as well as radar and camera
data, PID detects both the area directly around the
vehicle and the route ahead, determines the best
possible driving strategy in advance and adapts the
speed accordingly.
PID can assist the driver in the following situations:

### Vehicle driving ahead
`porsche_taycan_en_1040f98f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:186
If a vehicle was detected ahead, PID brakes if the
vehicle is driving slower than the set desired speed
and keeps the distance from the vehicle ahead constant in the preselected range. PID can continue
braking until your vehicle is stationary and starts
driving again automatically as soon as the vehicle in
front drives off again. A detected vehicle and the fact
that the vehicle has started driving again will be indicated on the instrument cluster.

### In bends
`porsche_taycan_en_47e8333e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:186
Navigation data and vehicle information is used to
adapt the speed to the road ahead.

### Tight bends detected in advance are displayed on
`porsche_taycan_en_e69455b7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:186
the instrument cluster and the speed of the vehicle
is reduced in good time. The speed calculated for the
bend is also indicated by the speed prediction system. If no bend ahead warning is displayed, the
speed will only be reduced slightly or will not be reduced at all. Vehicle handling in bends is also influenced by the selected drive mode.
At rotary intersections, junctions and on uphill and downhill slopes
When navigation is active or when the driver indicates in good time, PID reduces the speed before the
vehicle starts to change direction. A corresponding
display appears on the instrument cluster.
Information

### When route guidance is active in the navigation
`porsche_taycan_en_546cd6e2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:186
system, PID always orients itself according to the
proposed route. If route guidance is not active, it
adapts to the most plausible route.

### On roads with speed limits
`porsche_taycan_en_458bce20` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:186
PID uses navigation data and data from cameras
(traffic sign recognition) to automatically detect the
speed limit within the system limits and changes the
desired speed accordingly.

### Speed limits detected in advance are displayed on
`porsche_taycan_en_a410d0d3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:186
the instrument cluster and the speed of the vehicle
is reduced in good time. Otherwise, the speed is not
reduced until the vehicle is driving past the detected
traffic sign.

### At Stop and Yield signs
`porsche_taycan_en_55cba205` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:186
When approaching Stop and Yield signs, a message
appears on the instrument cluster and the speed is
reduced if the traffic signs are stored in the navigation data. It is up to the driver, however, to brake the
vehicle to a standstill.
If the driver accidentally continues driving at a Stop
sign, PID switches to passive mode and can be activated again afterwards by the driver.
If the driver continues driving at a Yield sign, PID remains active, passes the Yield sign at a reduced
speed and accelerates again to the previously set
speed as soon as the traffic situation allows it. The
previously set speed can be resumed again immediately by pressing RESUME.

Porsche Stability Management (PSM)
189

### Loss of control over the
`porsche_taycan_en_4a7abc0a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:191
vehicle
The PSM cannot reduce the risk of accidents due to
inappropriate speed.
The increased safety that is provided should not induce you to take greater risks with your safety. The
limits set by the laws of driving physics cannot be
overridden by PSM.
e
Despite PSM, drivers remain responsible for
adapting their driving style and maneuvers to the
road and weather conditions, as well as the traffic situation.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_d20b8b6e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:191
Porsche Stability Management (PSM) is a control
system for stabilizing the vehicle and is automatically active when driving readiness is established.
The major components of the PSM are the automatic brake differential (ASR), anti-slip regulation,
engine drag torque control and anti-lock braking
system (ABS).

### Reduced drive power
`porsche_taycan_en_4ef21900` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:191
–
A pulsing brake pedal and changes in brake pedal
position when braking

### Automatic brake differential
`porsche_taycan_en_98e70732` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:191
If one wheel on a driven axle starts to spin, it is
braked so that the other wheel on the same axle can
be driven.

### Anti-slip regulation
`porsche_taycan_en_466c9b70` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:191
Anti-slip regulation prevents wheels from spinning
through targeted adjustment of drive power, thereby
ensuring good lane-holding and stable handling.

### Drive drag torque control
`porsche_taycan_en_57f36af2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:191
In the event of excessive slip, drive drag torque control prevents all the driven wheels from locking up
during acceleration. This is also the case when
downshifting on slippery road surfaces.
Anti-lock braking system (ABS)

### ABS prevents the wheels from locking during full
`porsche_taycan_en_04dae88d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:191
braking.
>
Please see chapter "ABS brake system (anti-lock
braking system)" on page 190.

### Steering torque pulse
`porsche_taycan_en_acfc468f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:191
Steering torque pulse provides the driver with
steering assistance when braking on roads with
varying friction levels. Targeted impulses also assist
the driver during counter steering.

### Restricted PSM support
`porsche_taycan_en_39deff03` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:191
In PSM SPORT mode, the support provided by PSM
is restricted in critical driving situations outside the
ABS control range.

### Loss of control over the

The ABS cannot reduce the risk of accidents due to

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_2ec5ae79` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:192
The anti-lock braking system (ABS) prevents the
wheels from locking during full braking. This ensures
that the vehicle has enhanced driving stability and
maneuverability in hazardous situations.
ABS begins to take control as soon as one wheel
shows a tendency to lock.

### The controlled braking process is comparable to ca-
`porsche_taycan_en_7e24c802` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:192
dence braking in very rapid succession. The driver is
warned to adapt the driving speed to the road conditions by a pulsing brake pedal and a "juddering
noise".

### Fully depress the brake pedal during the entire
`porsche_taycan_en_714813a4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:192
braking operation, despite the pulsing pedal. Do
not reduce the braking pressure.

### Multi-collision braking
`porsche_taycan_en_dd30cbc6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:192
During an accident, multi-collision braking can help
the driver reduce the risk of skidding and further
collisions during the accident through automatically
initiated braking.
Prerequisites

### Multi-collision braking only happens:
`porsche_taycan_en_8425785d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:192
–
during front, side and rear-end collisions
–
when the airbag control unit detects an appropriate activation threshold during an accident
–
during an accident at a driving speed above approx. 5 mph (10 km/h)
Information

### The vehicle is decelerated automatically by the PSM
`porsche_taycan_en_614b33b1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:192
system, provided the hydraulic brake system, PSM,
and electrical system remain undamaged and operational during the accident.
Exceptions

nificant amount.
–
The braking pressure exerted by the driver on the
brake pedal is stronger than the brake pressure
applied by the system.

Porsche Vehicle Tracking System (PVTS)
191

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_eb457e65` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:193
PVTS is a GSM/GPS-based tracking system that allows a Security Operating Center (SOC) to locate the
vehicle if it is stolen. It can then be found by the
authorities.
Information

### On vehicles with the Porsche Connect or
`porsche_taycan_en_ed2479c5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:193
Car Connect smartphone app,1 a few settings can be
implemented directly using the app.
Detailed information on installation, the functions
and management of the contract can be found at:
www.porsche.com/connect.

### Scope of supply and initial
`porsche_taycan_en_35c53e9f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:193
activation
PVTS is tested by the authorized Porsche dealer and
activated together with the vehicle owner.
After activation, the vehicle owner will receive important documents, such as the phone number of
the local Security Operating Center (SOC) and your
service provider.

dealer.
Functions

your vehicle is stolen. In addition, report the theft

attentiveness.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_14551b64` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:195
Vehicles cannot or may not be detected in time in

–
Crossing road users approach extremely quickly.
–
If the rear bumper is dirty.

### Scope of functions
`porsche_taycan_en_fed0ecfb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:195
Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA) monitors the area
behind the vehicle and warns of any road users (e.g.
passenger vehicles, motorcycles, bicycles, pedestrians) crossing behind the vehicle when the driver is
backing out.

### Fig. 139: Rear Cross Traffic Alert display
`porsche_taycan_en_881906c3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:195
The system is available subject to the following
prerequisites:
–
Rear Cross Traffic Alert is switched on.
–
Porsche Stability Management (PSM) is
switched on.
–
Transmission range R is engaged.
–
The vehicle speed is less than approx.
10 mph (15 km/h).
When reverse gear is engaged, arrows appear on the
central display to alert the driver to approaching
crossing road users. Visual and acoustic signals warn
of the potential hazardous situation. If the driver
does not respond to the warning, the system performs a brief warning jolt to alert the driver to the
impending collision hazard.

on and off
e

system is stored in the selected account and paired
with the vehicle key used.

### An unsecured or incorrectly secured roof transport
`porsche_taycan_en_30214267` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:196
system can become detached from the vehicle while
driving and cause serious accidents.
e

### Individual attachment modules such as ski/
`porsche_taycan_en_64cef1b2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:196
snowboard holders or roof boxes must be positioned as centrally much as possible relative to
the leg supports.
e

### Check the roof transport system and attachment
`porsche_taycan_en_d6cecd89` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:196
modules before every trip and at regular intervals
during longer trips to make sure that they are
fitted correctly and securely.
e
Retighten all fastening screws.
WARNING

### Vehicle handling changes when the roof transport
`porsche_taycan_en_60a16ffa` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:196
system is mounted and loaded.
e
Adapt your driving style.
e
Do not drive at a speed of more than
81 mph (130 km/h) when the roof transport
system is loaded.
e
Do not drive at a speed of more than
110 mph (180 km/h) when the roof transport
system is mounted but not loaded.
WARNING

### An unsecured or incorrectly secured load can be-
`porsche_taycan_en_6066d8ee` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:196
come detached from the roof transport system while
driving and cause serious accidents.
e
Secure the load so that it cannot move during the
journey.
e
Load the roof transport system so that the load
does not protrude over the sides of the roof
transport system. Never exceed the width of the
vehicle.
e
Do not use elastic tensioners.
e
Position the center of gravity of the load as low
as possible with respect to the roof transport
system and distribute the load evenly over the
load area.
NOTICE
Washing the vehicle in a car wash or failure to observe the overall vehicle height or the maximum
permitted gross weight can damage the vehicle or
roof transport system.
e

### Check the overall vehicle height with the roof
`porsche_taycan_en_418337d2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:196
transport system fitted before driving into areas
with limited headroom (e.g. parking garages).
e
Do not exceed the maximum permitted roof load,
gross weight or maximum axle loads.
Information
e
When you are not using the roof transport system, remove it completely from the vehicle in
order to optimize energy consumption and reduce noise.

### Unfastened or incor-
`porsche_taycan_en_02aa3c9e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
rectly used seatbelts
A seatbelt that is not fastened will not provide any
protection in the event of an accident. A seatbelt
that is not fastened correctly can increase the risk of
injury in the event of an accident.
e

### All occupants must always fasten their seatbelts
`porsche_taycan_en_fabf5db4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
before the start of a journey.
e
Never allow two people to use the same seatbelt
at the same time.
e
Remove any loose articles of clothing (e.g. jacket), as they can interfere with the correct position of the seatbelt and restrict your freedom of
movement.
e

### Do not position seatbelts across hard or fragile
`porsche_taycan_en_8d062a30` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
objects (e.g. glasses, ball-point pen, cellphone,
etc.).
Objects of this kind pose an additional risk of
injury.
e
Make sure that the seatbelts are not twisted or
loose.
e

### Use appropriate child restraint systems for all
`porsche_taycan_en_f4b8e5e4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
children.
e
Seatbelts must be positioned on the body as to
restrain the upper body and lap from sliding forward. Improperly positioned seatbelts can cause
serious personal injury in case of an accident.
e

### The shoulder belt should always rest on your
`porsche_taycan_en_149df2ee` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:202
upper body. The shoulder belt should never be
worn behind your back or under your arm.
e
For maximum effectiveness, the lap belt should
be worn low across the hips.
e

### Pregnant women should position the seatbelt as
`porsche_taycan_en_673e41e9` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
low as possible across the pelvis. Make sure it is
not pressing against the abdomen.
e

### Regularly check all seatbelts for fabric damage
`porsche_taycan_en_bc3edd32` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
and check that the belt buckle and attachment
points are in good working order.
e
The seatbelts must be kept clean or the retractors may not work properly.
e

### Immediately replace any seatbelts that are dam-
`porsche_taycan_en_6b39dc74` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
aged or have been subjected to heavy strain
during an accident along with triggered seatbelt
pretensioner systems and force limiters.
e
In addition, you should have the anchorage
points of the seatbelts checked.

### The seatbelt pretensioner system can be trig-
`porsche_taycan_en_ec421a53` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
gered only once. Triggered belt tensioner systems must be replaced.
e

### Keep belt buckles free of any obstruction that
`porsche_taycan_en_cecb6106` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
may prevent secure locking.
e
If the seatbelts show damage to webbing, bindings, buckles or retractors, they should be replaced to ensure safe operation.
e

### Do not modify or disassemble the seatbelts in
`porsche_taycan_en_94a7683a` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202
your vehicle.
e
Never bleach or dye seatbelts.
e
Do not allow seatbelts to retract until they are
completely dry after cleaning or this may cause
damage to the belt.
>

`porsche_taycan_en_c918f913` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:202

the severity of the accident.

sioners are triggered. This does not necessarily mean
that the vehicle is on fire.

### Selecting the correct seat position
`porsche_taycan_en_93077e63` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
A correct sitting position is important to ensure safe
and fatigue-free driving. To adjust the position of the
driver's seat, proceed as follows:

### 1. Adjust the seat height to ensure that you have
`porsche_taycan_en_3bd9cbf4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
enough headroom and a good overview of the
vehicle.

### 2. Move the seat in the fore-and-aft direction so
`porsche_taycan_en_1563e67b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
that you can reach and press the pedals without
stretching your legs out completely. Your foot
should cover the entire surface of the pedal.

### 3. Grip the upper part of the steering wheel. Set the
`porsche_taycan_en_1175cb21` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:205
backrest angle and the steering wheel position
so that your arms are almost outstretched. Your
shoulders must still be touching the backrest.

### Removal of or Failure to
`porsche_taycan_en_d8bdb519` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:205
Adjust Headrest
Driving with removed headrests, improperly positioned headrests or improperly installed headrests
can cause serious personal injury or death in an
accident.
e
Adjust the headrests so that the upper edge of
the headrest is brought to eye level or higher.
e
Do not drive the vehicle without the headrest in
place and properly adjusted.
The vehicle is equipped with a total of 5 head restraints in the backrests of the the front and rear
seats (3 seats in the rear).
The vehicle is equipped with a total of 4 head restraints in the backrests of the the front and rear
seats (2 seats in the rear).
The driver seat and the front passenger seat provide
integrated head restraints in the backrests. The foreand-aft position of the head restraints on the front
seats can be adjusted (depending on type of seat).
The height position of the head restraints on the
front seats are not adjustable. The height of the head
restraints on the rear seats can be adjusted.

### Adjusting the seat while
`porsche_taycan_en_19f915a6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
driving
The seat can move further than intended if adjusted
while driving. You may lose control of the vehicle.
e
Do not adjust the seat while driving. The backrest locks must be engaged at all times while the
vehicle is in motion.

### The driver and front passenger seats provide inte-
`porsche_taycan_en_d3eaf857` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
grated head restraints in the backrests. The head
restraints are not adjustable. The rear seats do not
provide head restraints.
WARNING

### Failure to adjust
`porsche_taycan_en_d9fb5816` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
backrests
All occupants, including the driver, should not operate a vehicle or sit in a vehicle’s seat until the backrests are placed in their proper positions so that the
risk of neck injuries is minimized in the event of a
crash.
e

Speed Limiter (LIM)

### If the system-induced deceleration is insuffi-
`porsche_taycan_en_277cbfaa` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:212
cient, slow the vehicle down immediately using

e
Make sure that you can take control of the vehicle at any time.

### The speed limit is not detected or adopted
`porsche_taycan_en_79ec18d5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:212
correctly.
–
The vehicle drives at the set maximum speed.
–

### An information message is displayed on the in-
`porsche_taycan_en_f905fcad` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
strument cluster.
e
Do not use the adaptive speed limiter in the following situations:
–
poor weather conditions (e.g. snow or ice)
–
unfavorable road conditions (including pot
holes, dirty road surfaces, ruts, unclear road
markings, loose gravel)
–
areas with high volumes of traffic
–
unsafe traffic situations (driving on highway
on and off-ramps, accelerating briefly)
–
a vehicle position that cannot be clearly detected by the system
–
covered or damaged traffic signs
–
damaged or covered front camera lens
–
out-of-date navigation data

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_5cff7ba3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:212
The speed limiter (LIM) helps you to stay below a
certain speed you set yourself.
Adaptive speed limiter (depending on the
country)

### The adaptive speed limiter uses navigation and
`porsche_taycan_en_9145f4de` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
camera data to automatically detect the speed limit
within the system limits and changes the maximum
speed accordingly.

### Speed limits detected in advance are displayed on
`porsche_taycan_en_744e0974` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
the instrument cluster, and the speed of the vehicle
is reduced in good time. If a speed limit is not detected in advance, the speed is not reduced until the
vehicle is driving past the detected traffic sign.
Information
When using navigation with active route guidance,
the adaptive speed limiter always adapts to the proposed route. If route guidance is not active, it adapts
to the most plausible route.

### A distinction is made between readiness for opera-
`porsche_taycan_en_fa700001` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
tion (standby) and readiness to drive. Both are activated separately.

### Operational readiness
`porsche_taycan_en_2a748029` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:218
When you get into the vehicle, the key you have with
you is detected by the vehicle, and readiness for
operation is established automatically. Some electrical equipment and electronic systems, such as the
central display, are available.
e
To save the battery, only leave the vehicle in
standby (ready for operation) and only use the
active electrical equipment for as long as is absolutely necessary.

### Readiness to drive
`porsche_taycan_en_0247c048` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
Selecting transmission range D, N or R establishes
driving readiness. The vehicle is now ready to drive
and can be moved.

### R — Reverse gear
`porsche_taycan_en_d1ad8839` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:218
Drive position R for driving in reverse.
Only engage when the vehicle is stationary and the
brake is applied.

### N — Neutral
`porsche_taycan_en_8a4c30f4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
Transmission range N must be engaged in car
washes, for example.

### P — Park
`porsche_taycan_en_798f9076` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:218
Drive position P for securing the vehicle.
Drive positions D, R and N are selected using the
selector lever to the right of the steering wheel,
while drive position P is selected by pressing the P
button.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_bd5732f0` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:220
During recuperation, the drive converts most of the
kinetic energy into electrical energy, which is stored
in the high-voltage battery. There are two types of
recuperation - overrun recuperation and braking
recuperation:
–

### Overrun recuperation starts as soon as you take
`porsche_taycan_en_fa80ca77` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:220
your foot off the accelerator pedal and slows
down the vehicle. You can configure the overrun
recuperation strength.
–
When you press the brakes, braking recuperation increases the amount of recuperated energy
to a maximum. A higher braking request is then
achieved using the vehicle's wheel brakes.

### Variable adaptation of over-
`porsche_taycan_en_87f18a51` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
run recuperation based on
data relating to the area
around the vehicle.
Information

### The deceleration effect of overrun recuperation can
`porsche_taycan_en_c2a89322` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:220
be limited if the charge state of the high-voltage
battery is high, for example.
e

### Press and hold = Switch automatic overrun
`porsche_taycan_en_136c0736` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
recuperation (Auto) on and off
– or –
e
Drive e Recuperation (accelerator)

### Automatic overrun recuperation is only available
`porsche_taycan_en_35805215` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
when PSM is active. Automatic overrun recuperation
is not available in "PSM SPORT" mode.
Information

### The various overrun recuperation settings are as-
`porsche_taycan_en_a111bfc1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
signed to the drive modes, but can also be freely
selected by the driver.

### Driving in coasting mode
`porsche_taycan_en_81198d3c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
"Coasting" is the term used to describe driving
without the braking effect of overrun recuperation.

### This function is designed to increase efficiency by
`porsche_taycan_en_8b107ecf` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
reducing power consumption. Coasting starts when
the accelerator pedal is released slowly and fully.

### Coasting ends when the accelerator pedal is
`porsche_taycan_en_8f683ed7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
pressed.
b Driving in transmission range D.
b PSM is active.
b No major inclines or slopes.
b Recuperation is switched off.
e

### Coasting mode is also possible in "SPORT" and
`porsche_taycan_en_bcd6021d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
"SPORT PLUS" drive modes. The overrun recuperation setting that is activated as standard for these
drive modes must be switched off when selecting
these modes.

### Power steering and brake force boosting are only
`porsche_taycan_en_ccd9ea32` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:220
active when operational readiness is established. If
the vehicle is not ready for operation, a much greater
force will need to be applied during steering or
braking.
e

### Only switch off operational readiness when the
`porsche_taycan_en_8e1bef51` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
vehicle is at a standstill.

### Failure of camera to de-
`porsche_taycan_en_0e3e296e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:229
tect traffic signs
The camera's view can be impaired by various influencing factors (e.g. rain, snow, ice, heavy spray, oncoming headlights, reflections, dirt, damage).
In some circumstances, the camera may not detect
traffic signs or may detect them incorrectly, which
will result in a speed limit or bend ahead warning not
being displayed or being displayed incorrectly. Traffic signs always take precedence.
e
Always pay attention to traffic signs.
e
Drive with extreme care.
e
Always keep your eyes on the road ahead.
e
Clean the camera lens regularly and keep it free
of snow and ice.
e
Do not cover the camera lens and check for
damage at regular intervals.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_536488bf` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:229
The assistance provided by the system cannot be
guaranteed if traffic signs are covered or damaged.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_3a4d6236` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:229
Traffic sign detection (available in some countries)
detects speed restrictions, the start and end of no
overtaking zones and curve ahead signs. The traffic
signs are evaluated in conjunction with the camera
(A) and the map data stored in the navigation system and displayed in the instrument cluster.
If a traffic sign is restricted to a certain time or specific weather conditions (e.g. fog or rain), the detected sign is compared with the vehicle information
(e.g. rain sensor, navigation data and time) and displayed if relevant.

### In countries where traffic sign detection is not
`porsche_taycan_en_dd267d34` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:229
available, a message will appear in the instrument
cluster.

### Bend ahead warning
`porsche_taycan_en_a98a620b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:229
Up to three main traffic signs (A) including the curve
ahead warning (B) can be displayed on the instrument cluster. The traffic sign with the highest priority is on the left.
The curve ahead warning (C) is displayed approx.
500 ft. (150 m) before a curve and remains displayed until the curve has been passed.

### Speed limit display
`porsche_taycan_en_24f8cde5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:229
The most recently valid speed limit appears in the
instrument cluster once the vehicle is switched on
and ready to drive. If no speed limit was detected or
if traffic sign detection is not available in the current
1.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_0811785e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:243
Within the system limits, the system can warn
against impending frontal collisions and initiate appropriate braking maneuvers (depending on the
country) or provide steering support (depending on
the equipment). Not all road users and dangerous
situations can be detected correctly and in time.
The side areas of the vehicle and the rear are not
monitored.
In complex driving situations, the system may issue
undesired warnings and perform undesired braking
interventions.
Depending on the danger detected, not all Warning
and Brake Assist protection measures might be
triggered.
The system is available as of walking speed and can
react to pedestrians or cyclists up to a speed of
approx. 53 mph (85 km/h). It can react to vehicles
up to a speed of 156 mph (250 km/h).
The system does not react to animals, cross traffic
or objects such as poles, fences or rail vehicles.
On vehicles with Turn Assist, the system also reacts
to oncoming vehicles.

`porsche_taycan_en_77021d20` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:244

### Collision warning1
`porsche_taycan_en_8ef51e07` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:244
Fig. 197: Collision warning on the instrument cluster
If the system detects a possible collision, it can warn
the driver by issuing a warning tone and displaying a
warning on the instrument cluster.
Acute warning (warning jolt)1
If the driver does not respond to the collision warning, a warning jolt is performed in addition to the
warning tone and display of the symbol on the instrument cluster.
With the warning jolt, the system draws attention to
the increasing danger of collision.
Even with this warning, the driver may still have to
swerve or brake sharply in order to avoid a collision.

### Automatic braking and braking
`porsche_taycan_en_989635a3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:244
assistance1
If the driver does not respond to the acute warning
or does not brake sufficiently, the warning assistant
and BrakeAssist can assist the driver with braking by
progressively increasing braking force or braking the
vehicle to a standstill.
In addition, a warning tone is emitted and a symbol
appears on the instrument cluster as well.
Reducing the vehicle speed can help to mitigate the
consequences of a potential accident.
Information

### Automatic braking interventions can be aborted with
`porsche_taycan_en_02122e0c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:244
the following measures:
e
Press the brake pedal.
e
Fully depress the accelerator pedal.
e
Actively steer.
Information
Once the vehicle has reached a standstill, it is not
held constantly by the brake system.
e

### Swerve Assist
`porsche_taycan_en_8ef61ca5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:244
The Swerve Assist can help to steer the vehicle
around an obstacle in hazardous situations.
If the system detects a critical situation and the
driver actively avoids the obstacle after the urgent
warning, Swerve Assist will support the driver by
selectively braking individual wheels and correcting
the steering angle with a slight steering movement.
If Swerve Assist is active, automatic braking or
braking assistance will be canceled.

### System limitations
