### Selecting the correct seat position
`porsche_taycan_en_93077e63` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
A correct sitting position is important to ensure safe
and fatigue-free driving. To adjust the position of the
driver's seat, proceed as follows:

### 1. Adjust the seat height to ensure that you have
`porsche_taycan_en_3bd9cbf4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
enough headroom and a good overview of the
vehicle.

### 2. Move the seat in the fore-and-aft direction so
`porsche_taycan_en_1563e67b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
that you can reach and press the pedals without
stretching your legs out completely. Your foot
should cover the entire surface of the pedal.

### 3. Grip the upper part of the steering wheel. Set the
`porsche_taycan_en_1175cb21` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:205
backrest angle and the steering wheel position
so that your arms are almost outstretched. Your
shoulders must still be touching the backrest.

### Removal of or Failure to
`porsche_taycan_en_d8bdb519` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:205
Adjust Headrest
Driving with removed headrests, improperly positioned headrests or improperly installed headrests
can cause serious personal injury or death in an
accident.
e
Adjust the headrests so that the upper edge of
the headrest is brought to eye level or higher.
e
Do not drive the vehicle without the headrest in
place and properly adjusted.
The vehicle is equipped with a total of 5 head restraints in the backrests of the the front and rear
seats (3 seats in the rear).
The vehicle is equipped with a total of 4 head restraints in the backrests of the the front and rear
seats (2 seats in the rear).
The driver seat and the front passenger seat provide
integrated head restraints in the backrests. The foreand-aft position of the head restraints on the front
seats can be adjusted (depending on type of seat).
The height position of the head restraints on the
front seats are not adjustable. The height of the head
restraints on the rear seats can be adjusted.

### Adjusting the seat while
`porsche_taycan_en_19f915a6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
driving
The seat can move further than intended if adjusted
while driving. You may lose control of the vehicle.
e
Do not adjust the seat while driving. The backrest locks must be engaged at all times while the
vehicle is in motion.

### The driver and front passenger seats provide inte-
`porsche_taycan_en_d3eaf857` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
grated head restraints in the backrests. The head
restraints are not adjustable. The rear seats do not
provide head restraints.
WARNING

### Failure to adjust
`porsche_taycan_en_d9fb5816` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
backrests
All occupants, including the driver, should not operate a vehicle or sit in a vehicle’s seat until the backrests are placed in their proper positions so that the
risk of neck injuries is minimized in the event of a
crash.
e

### Seat adjustment
`porsche_taycan_en_1bb3c5d7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:205
If persons or animals are in the movement range of
the seat during seat adjustment, there is a risk of
parts of the body being pinched or crushed.
e
Ensure that no one is put at risk when adjusting
the seat.
e
Do not activate the memory button if anything or
anyone is in the way.
e

### Cancel automatic adjustment by pressing any of
`porsche_taycan_en_fb382bc4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:205
the seat adjustment buttons.
NOTICE
Risk of damage to windshield, sun visor, wind deflector, etc. when the seat is adjusted or folded back
or forward.
e
Adjust the seat so that the seat backrest is not in
contact with any other object.

Speed Limiter (LIM)

### If the system-induced deceleration is insuffi-
`porsche_taycan_en_277cbfaa` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:212
cient, slow the vehicle down immediately using

e
Make sure that you can take control of the vehicle at any time.

### The speed limit is not detected or adopted
`porsche_taycan_en_79ec18d5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:212
correctly.
–
The vehicle drives at the set maximum speed.
–

### An information message is displayed on the in-
`porsche_taycan_en_f905fcad` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
strument cluster.
e
Do not use the adaptive speed limiter in the following situations:
–
poor weather conditions (e.g. snow or ice)
–
unfavorable road conditions (including pot
holes, dirty road surfaces, ruts, unclear road
markings, loose gravel)
–
areas with high volumes of traffic
–
unsafe traffic situations (driving on highway
on and off-ramps, accelerating briefly)
–
a vehicle position that cannot be clearly detected by the system
–
covered or damaged traffic signs
–
damaged or covered front camera lens
–
out-of-date navigation data

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_5cff7ba3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:212
The speed limiter (LIM) helps you to stay below a
certain speed you set yourself.
Adaptive speed limiter (depending on the
country)

### The adaptive speed limiter uses navigation and
`porsche_taycan_en_9145f4de` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
camera data to automatically detect the speed limit
within the system limits and changes the maximum
speed accordingly.

### Speed limits detected in advance are displayed on
`porsche_taycan_en_744e0974` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:212
the instrument cluster, and the speed of the vehicle
is reduced in good time. If a speed limit is not detected in advance, the speed is not reduced until the
vehicle is driving past the detected traffic sign.
Information
When using navigation with active route guidance,
the adaptive speed limiter always adapts to the proposed route. If route guidance is not active, it adapts
to the most plausible route.

`porsche_taycan_en_611c9b7c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:214
e

### Resuming control
`porsche_taycan_en_00aedafe` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:214
b The current driving speed is lower than the set
maximum speed.
e
Press the control lever upward once (RESUME).
The speed limiter is active.
– or –
b The current driving speed is higher than the set
maximum speed.

### 1. Press the control lever upward once (RESUME).
`porsche_taycan_en_c80d1229` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:214
2. Take your foot off the accelerator or press the
brake pedal to bring the speed of the vehicle to
below the displayed maximum speed.
– or –
Press the control lever upward twice (RESUME).
The vehicle is then slowed down, until the set
maximum speed or the currently detected speed
limit is reached again.
The speed limiter is active.
Information
The speed limiter is interrupted if another driver assistance system is selected. The last maximum
speed entered remains in the system and is resumed
when the speed limiter is reactivated. If the speed
limiter is active, then the currently detected speed
limit is used.

passing, for example.

maximum speed, the vehicle is slowed down until the set maximum speed is reached again.
– or –

### A distinction is made between readiness for opera-
`porsche_taycan_en_fa700001` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
tion (standby) and readiness to drive. Both are activated separately.

### Operational readiness
`porsche_taycan_en_2a748029` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:218
When you get into the vehicle, the key you have with
you is detected by the vehicle, and readiness for
operation is established automatically. Some electrical equipment and electronic systems, such as the
central display, are available.
e
To save the battery, only leave the vehicle in
standby (ready for operation) and only use the
active electrical equipment for as long as is absolutely necessary.

### Readiness to drive
`porsche_taycan_en_0247c048` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
Selecting transmission range D, N or R establishes
driving readiness. The vehicle is now ready to drive
and can be moved.

### R — Reverse gear
`porsche_taycan_en_d1ad8839` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:218
Drive position R for driving in reverse.
Only engage when the vehicle is stationary and the
brake is applied.

### N — Neutral
`porsche_taycan_en_8a4c30f4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:218
Transmission range N must be engaged in car
washes, for example.

### P — Park
`porsche_taycan_en_798f9076` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:218
Drive position P for securing the vehicle.
Drive positions D, R and N are selected using the
selector lever to the right of the steering wheel,
while drive position P is selected by pressing the P
button.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_bd5732f0` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:220
During recuperation, the drive converts most of the
kinetic energy into electrical energy, which is stored
in the high-voltage battery. There are two types of
recuperation - overrun recuperation and braking
recuperation:
–

### Overrun recuperation starts as soon as you take
`porsche_taycan_en_fa80ca77` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:220
your foot off the accelerator pedal and slows
down the vehicle. You can configure the overrun
recuperation strength.
–
When you press the brakes, braking recuperation increases the amount of recuperated energy
to a maximum. A higher braking request is then
achieved using the vehicle's wheel brakes.

### Variable adaptation of over-
`porsche_taycan_en_87f18a51` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
run recuperation based on
data relating to the area
around the vehicle.
Information

### The deceleration effect of overrun recuperation can
`porsche_taycan_en_c2a89322` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:220
be limited if the charge state of the high-voltage
battery is high, for example.
e

### Press and hold = Switch automatic overrun
`porsche_taycan_en_136c0736` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
recuperation (Auto) on and off
– or –
e
Drive e Recuperation (accelerator)

### Automatic overrun recuperation is only available
`porsche_taycan_en_35805215` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
when PSM is active. Automatic overrun recuperation
is not available in "PSM SPORT" mode.
Information

### The various overrun recuperation settings are as-
`porsche_taycan_en_a111bfc1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
signed to the drive modes, but can also be freely
selected by the driver.

### Driving in coasting mode
`porsche_taycan_en_81198d3c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
"Coasting" is the term used to describe driving
without the braking effect of overrun recuperation.

### This function is designed to increase efficiency by
`porsche_taycan_en_8b107ecf` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
reducing power consumption. Coasting starts when
the accelerator pedal is released slowly and fully.

### Coasting ends when the accelerator pedal is
`porsche_taycan_en_8f683ed7` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
pressed.
b Driving in transmission range D.
b PSM is active.
b No major inclines or slopes.
b Recuperation is switched off.
e

### Coasting mode is also possible in "SPORT" and
`porsche_taycan_en_bcd6021d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:220
"SPORT PLUS" drive modes. The overrun recuperation setting that is activated as standard for these
drive modes must be switched off when selecting
these modes.

### Power steering and brake force boosting are only
`porsche_taycan_en_ccd9ea32` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:220
active when operational readiness is established. If
the vehicle is not ready for operation, a much greater
force will need to be applied during steering or
braking.
e

### Only switch off operational readiness when the
`porsche_taycan_en_8e1bef51` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:220
vehicle is at a standstill.

### Risk of the vehicle rolling
`porsche_taycan_en_c7845630` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:221
away
In the following situations, the parking brake is not
active and the vehicle may roll away.
–

### When leaving the vehicle with drive position N
`porsche_taycan_en_241fc3ad` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:221
engaged.
–
If the driver's door is open and the driver's seatbelt is unfastened, pressing the brake pedal and
selecting drive position D or R again will deactivate the parking brake,
which can cause injuries and damage the vehicle. A
warning on the instrument cluster indicates that
there is a danger of the vehicle rolling away.
e
Before leaving the vehicle, activate the parking
brake by pressing the P button.

### Stopping the vehicle
`porsche_taycan_en_3255b89e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:221
e
Press the brake pedal until the vehicle comes to
a standstill.

When stopping briefly, stop the vehicle with
the brake pedal and leave the selector lever in
transmission range D.
On gradients, the vehicle is automatically held
stationary using the HOLD function.

### Failure of camera to de-
`porsche_taycan_en_0e3e296e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:229
tect traffic signs
The camera's view can be impaired by various influencing factors (e.g. rain, snow, ice, heavy spray, oncoming headlights, reflections, dirt, damage).
In some circumstances, the camera may not detect
traffic signs or may detect them incorrectly, which
will result in a speed limit or bend ahead warning not
being displayed or being displayed incorrectly. Traffic signs always take precedence.
e
Always pay attention to traffic signs.
e
Drive with extreme care.
e
Always keep your eyes on the road ahead.
e
Clean the camera lens regularly and keep it free
of snow and ice.
e
Do not cover the camera lens and check for
damage at regular intervals.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_536488bf` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:229
The assistance provided by the system cannot be
guaranteed if traffic signs are covered or damaged.

### Operating principle
`porsche_taycan_en_3a4d6236` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:229
Traffic sign detection (available in some countries)
detects speed restrictions, the start and end of no
overtaking zones and curve ahead signs. The traffic
signs are evaluated in conjunction with the camera
(A) and the map data stored in the navigation system and displayed in the instrument cluster.
If a traffic sign is restricted to a certain time or specific weather conditions (e.g. fog or rain), the detected sign is compared with the vehicle information
(e.g. rain sensor, navigation data and time) and displayed if relevant.

### In countries where traffic sign detection is not
`porsche_taycan_en_dd267d34` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:229
available, a message will appear in the instrument
cluster.

### Bend ahead warning
`porsche_taycan_en_a98a620b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:229
Up to three main traffic signs (A) including the curve
ahead warning (B) can be displayed on the instrument cluster. The traffic sign with the highest priority is on the left.
The curve ahead warning (C) is displayed approx.
500 ft. (150 m) before a curve and remains displayed until the curve has been passed.

### Speed limit display
`porsche_taycan_en_24f8cde5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:229
The most recently valid speed limit appears in the
instrument cluster once the vehicle is switched on
and ready to drive. If no speed limit was detected or
if traffic sign detection is not available in the current

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_0811785e` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:243
Within the system limits, the system can warn
against impending frontal collisions and initiate appropriate braking maneuvers (depending on the
country) or provide steering support (depending on
the equipment). Not all road users and dangerous
situations can be detected correctly and in time.
The side areas of the vehicle and the rear are not
monitored.
In complex driving situations, the system may issue
undesired warnings and perform undesired braking
interventions.
Depending on the danger detected, not all Warning
and Brake Assist protection measures might be
triggered.
The system is available as of walking speed and can
react to pedestrians or cyclists up to a speed of
approx. 53 mph (85 km/h). It can react to vehicles
up to a speed of 156 mph (250 km/h).
The system does not react to animals, cross traffic
or objects such as poles, fences or rail vehicles.
On vehicles with Turn Assist, the system also reacts
to oncoming vehicles.

### Distance warning
`porsche_taycan_en_ae616ac5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:244
If Warn and Brake Assist detects a safety hazard due
to driving too closely to the vehicle in front, the
driver is warned by the
display on the instrument
cluster1.

### Detection is possible within a driving speed range
`porsche_taycan_en_77021d20` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:244
from approx. 40 mph (65 km/h) to
156 mph (250 km/h).

### Collision warning1
`porsche_taycan_en_8ef51e07` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:244
Fig. 197: Collision warning on the instrument cluster
If the system detects a possible collision, it can warn
the driver by issuing a warning tone and displaying a
warning on the instrument cluster.
Acute warning (warning jolt)1
If the driver does not respond to the collision warning, a warning jolt is performed in addition to the
warning tone and display of the symbol on the instrument cluster.
With the warning jolt, the system draws attention to
the increasing danger of collision.
Even with this warning, the driver may still have to
swerve or brake sharply in order to avoid a collision.

### Automatic braking and braking
`porsche_taycan_en_989635a3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:244
assistance1
If the driver does not respond to the acute warning
or does not brake sufficiently, the warning assistant
and BrakeAssist can assist the driver with braking by
progressively increasing braking force or braking the
vehicle to a standstill.
In addition, a warning tone is emitted and a symbol
appears on the instrument cluster as well.
Reducing the vehicle speed can help to mitigate the
consequences of a potential accident.
Information

### Automatic braking interventions can be aborted with
`porsche_taycan_en_02122e0c` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:244
the following measures:
e
Press the brake pedal.
e
Fully depress the accelerator pedal.
e
Actively steer.
Information
Once the vehicle has reached a standstill, it is not
held constantly by the brake system.
e

### Swerve Assist
`porsche_taycan_en_8ef61ca5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:244
The Swerve Assist can help to steer the vehicle
around an obstacle in hazardous situations.
If the system detects a critical situation and the
driver actively avoids the obstacle after the urgent
warning, Swerve Assist will support the driver by
selectively braking individual wheels and correcting
the steering angle with a slight steering movement.
If Swerve Assist is active, automatic braking or
braking assistance will be canceled.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_3d866b4b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:244
Swerve Assist is available at speeds from
30 mph (50 km/h) - 93 mph (150 km/h).

### Turn Assist
`porsche_taycan_en_9df55859` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:244
Turn Assist can help when driving off or when driving
slowly by initiating braking intervention so that the
vehicle does not collide with an oncoming vehicle
when turning left2 The braking intervention keeps
the vehicle in its own lane.

### System limitations
`porsche_taycan_en_3d866b4b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:244
Turn Assist is only available when the turn signal is
activated and up to a maximum speed of
6 mph (10 km/h).
1.
Availability dependent on country.
2.
Country-dependent: Turn Assist is available in countries with right-hand traffic only when turning left and in countries with left-hand traffic only when turning right.

### Seat belt system optimization
`porsche_taycan_en_6557af30` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:245
When driving off, the front seat belts are gently
tightened once.
It is activated upon reaching a driving speed of approx. 20 mph (30 km/h) or when the seat belts are
fastened again.

### Preconditioning of the seat belt and passen-
`porsche_taycan_en_d657d117` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:245
ger compartment
In dangerous situations, Warn and Brake Assist can
initiate measures to prepare for a possible collision in
order to support the effectiveness of the passive
occupant protection system. For this purpose, the
front seat belts are pretensioned, open side windows
are closed and (depending on equipment) the front
seat side bolsters are inflated, depending on the
situation.

### The preventive occupant protection measures can
`porsche_taycan_en_4f335638` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:245
be activated within the limits of the system in the
following situations:
–

### During automatic braking intervention initiated
`porsche_taycan_en_591a2fd5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:245
by the vehicle
As soon as the detected collision hazard has passed
and a stable driving condition is achieved, the preconditioning measures are ended and existing seat
belt tension is released again.

### Limits of the system
`porsche_taycan_en_0d0397a1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:245
–
In the case of repeated activation (e.g. in the
context of driver safety training), the belt tension
increases progressively so that it may no longer
be possible to reliably release the belt tensioning.
In this case, unfasten and refasten the seat belt
or deactivate Warn and Brake Assist.
–
In the event of a defect in the reversible belt
tensioner, the preventive occupant protection
measures are only available to a limited extent.
–

### The seat-belt pretensioner may be damaged fol-
`porsche_taycan_en_7a3fe0d8` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:245
lowing an accident. Visit an authorized Porsche
dealer. Porsche recommends an authorized Porsche dealer, as they have trained technicians and
the necessary parts and tools.
–

`porsche_taycan_en_4b8f70af` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:245
off, the preventive occupant protection functions
of Warn and Brake Assist are deactivated.

Driving the vehicle with low tire pressure increases

Furthermore, low tire pressure increases rate of wear
of the affected tires and causes damage.

and thus from leakage. Always screw caps tightly
down. Replace missing caps immediately.

Use only plastic valve caps.

For safety reasons, don't use tire inflating
bottles.

cause the tire pressure to fall below the prescribed value.

### Tire Pressure Monitoring System
`porsche_taycan_en_aec28e44` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:255
(TPMS)
Each tire, including the spare (if provided), should be
checked monthly when cold and inflated to the inflation pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer on the vehicle placard or tire inflation
pressure label. (If your vehicle has tires of a different
size than the size indicated on the vehicle placard or
tire inflation pressure label, you should determine
the proper tire inflation pressure for those tires.)
As an added safety feature, your vehicle has been
equipped with a Tire Pressure Monitoring System
(TPMS) that illuminates a low tire pressure telltale
when one or more of your tires is significantly underinflated. Accordingly, when the tire pressure warning
light comes on, you should stop, check your tires as
soon as possible, and inflate them to the proper
pressure. Driving on a significantly under-inflated
tire causes the tire to overheat and can lead to tire
failure. Under-inflation also reduces fuel efficiency
and tire tread life, and may affect the vehicle’s handling and stopping ability.
Please note that the TPMS is not a substitute for
proper tire maintenance, and it is the driver's responsibility to maintain correct tire pressure, even if
under-inflation has not reached the level to trigger
illumination of the TPMS low tire pressure telltale.
The display as well as the settings for the Tire Pressure Monitoring System take place on the multifunction display. However, the tires still have to be
inflated manually.
>

### Permanent monitoring of tire pressure and tire
`porsche_taycan_en_8f9871d1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:255
temperature.
–
Displays the actual tire pressure (actual pressure) while driving.
–
Tire pressure warnings in two stages (yellow and
red warning).
–

### The tire pressure warning light
`porsche_taycan_en_e19c4d73` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:255
and a corresponding message on the instrument cluster warn
against loss of pressure in two stages (yellow and
red tire pressure warning, depending on the extent
of the pressure loss).
The tire pressure warning light only goes out when
the tire pressure has been corrected to the set
pressure.

### The yellow tire pressure warning is displayed for
`porsche_taycan_en_afec6b1f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:255
around 10 seconds when the vehicle is stationary
and switched off or when the vehicle is switched on
again. The yellow tire pressure warning can be
acknowledged when the vehicle is switched on. The
red tire pressure warning also appears while traveling and can be acknowledged.
e
If the tire pressure warning light comes on and a
tire pressure warning is displayed even with a
correct tire pressure: Visit an authorized Porsche
dealer. Porsche recommends an authorized Porsche dealer, as they have trained technicians and
the necessary parts and tools.
Information

### The tire pressure monitoring system issues warnings
`porsche_taycan_en_0c63be9d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:255
relating to loss of pressure due to natural diffusion
and gradual loss of pressure caused by foreign
bodies. The Tire Pressure Monitoring System cannot
warn you about tire damage that occurs suddenly (e.
g. a flat tire due to unexpected external effects).
WARNING

### Malfunctions in the tire pressure monitoring
`porsche_taycan_en_43d355a6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:256
system
Your vehicle has also been equipped with a TPMS
malfunction indicator to indicate when the system is
not operating properly. The TPMS malfunction indicator is combined with the low tire pressure telltale.
When the system detects a malfunction, the telltale
will flash for approximately one minute and then remain continuously illuminated. This sequence will
continue upon subsequent vehicle start-ups as long
as the malfunction exists. When the malfunction indicator is illuminated, the system may not be able to
detect or signal low tire pressure as intended. TPMS
malfunctions may occur for a variety of reasons, including the installation of replacement or alternate
tires or wheels on the vehicle that prevent the TPMS
from functioning properly. Always check the TPMS
malfunction telltale after replacing one or more tires
or wheels on your vehicle to ensure that the replacement or alternate tires and wheels allow the
TPMS to continue to function properly.

tire pressures are valid for all types of vehicle load.

### Learning theTire Pressure Monitoring System
`porsche_taycan_en_6f0fefd1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:257
After the tires have been changed, the wheel sensor
has been replaced, or the tire settings have been
updated, the Tire Pressure Monitoring System starts
learning the tires. The tire pressure control system
recognizes the wheels and their installation position.
The position and pressure data is available as soon
as theTire Pressure Monitoring System has assigned
the recognized wheels to the correct wheel position.
During the learning process, the target pressures for
cold tires (68 °F) are shown on the central display,
and a message appears on the instrument cluster.

### The tire pressure warning light
`porsche_taycan_en_36e44aeb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:257
in the instrument
cluster remains illuminated until the information for
all of the tires has been learned.

### Wheels and Tires
`porsche_taycan_en_d64e0c07` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:258
256
Fig. 202: Treadwear, Traction and Temperature of the Tire
Quality grades can be found where applicable on the
tire sidewall between tread shoulder and maximum
section width. All passenger vehicle tires must conform to Federal Safety Requirements in addition to
these grades. Quality grades can be found where
applicable.
Treadwear

### The treadwear grade is a comparative rating based
`porsche_taycan_en_d2229c98` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:258
on the wear rate of the tire when tested under controlled conditions on a specific government test
course. For example, a tire graded 150 would wear
one and a half (1-1/2) times as well on the government course as a tire graded 100. The relative performance of tires depends upon the actual
conditions of their use, however, and may depart
significantly from the norm due to variations in driving habits, service practices and differences in road
characteristics and climate.
>

### Please see chapter "Checking tire tread" on
`porsche_taycan_en_108c7bf9` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:258
page 260.
Traction AA, A, B, C
The traction grades, from highest to lowest, are AA,
A, B, and C and they represent the tire's ability to
stop on wet pavement as measured under controlled
conditions on specified government test surfaces of
asphalt and concrete. A tire marked C may have poor
traction performance.
Information
The traction grade assigned to this is based on
braking (straight-ahead) traction tests and does not
include cornering (turned) traction, acceleration, hydroplaning or peak traction characteristics.
Temperature A, B, C
The temperature grades are A (the highest), B and C,
representing the tire's resistance to the generation
of heat and its ability to dissipate heat when tested
under controlled conditions on a specified indoor
laboratory test wheel.

### Sustained high temperatures can cause the material
`porsche_taycan_en_435ad656` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:258
of the tire to degenerate and reduce tire life, and
excessive temperature can lead to sudden tire
failure.
The grade C corresponds to a level of performance
which all passenger vehicle tires must meet under
the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 109.
Grades B and A represent higher levels of performance on the laboratory test wheel than the minimum
required by law.

### Glossary of tire terminology
`porsche_taycan_en_47c2c631` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:258
Radial ply tire
A pneumatic tire in which the ply cords which extend
to the beads are laid at substantially 90° to the centerline of the tread.
Ply
A layer of rubber-coated parallel cords.
Cord
The strands forming the plies in the tire.
Rim
A metal support for a tire or a tire and tube assembly
upon which the tire beads are seated.
Bead
The part of the tire made of steel wires, wrapped or
reinforced by ply cords, that is shaped to fit the rim.
Sidewall
The portion of a tire between the tread and the bead.
Tread
The portion of the tire that comes in contact with
the road.

per square inch (psi) or bar.

`porsche_taycan_en_a4b500de` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:262

### The original equipment tires on your Porsche
`porsche_taycan_en_513a8ba9` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:262
have built-in tire wear indicators. They are
molded into the bottom of the tread grooves and
will appear as approximately 1/2 in. (12 mm)
bands when the tire tread depth is down to 1/16
of an in (1.6 mm).
e
When the indicators appear in two or more adjacent grooves, it is time to replace the tires. We
recommend, however, that you do not let the
tires wear down to this extent.
e

### Worn tires cannot grip the road surface properly
`porsche_taycan_en_04e39d44` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:262
and are even less effective on wet roads.
e
For safety reasons, replace the tires before the
wear indicators appear. Snow tires are no longer
suitable when their tread depth falls below 5/32
in. (4 mm).
e
In the United States, state laws may govern the
minimum tread depth permissible. Follow all
such laws.

### Storing wheels
`porsche_taycan_en_cf8e7ef6` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:262
Do not use tires that are more than 6 years old.
Chemical additives, which make the tire rubber
elastic, lose their effectiveness over the course of
time and the rubber becomes brittle. The age of the
tire can be seen from the "DOT" code number shown
on the tire sidewall. If, for example, the last four
numbers are 3016, then the tire was produced in the
30th week of 2016.
e
Always store wheels in a cool, dry and dark place.
Store tires without rims vertically.
e
Do not store summer tires or park vehicles with
summer tires mounted at ambient temperatures
under 5 °F (-15 °C).
e
Avoid contact with gas, oil or grease.

(summer tires) and before winter (M+S tires) by an
authorized Porsche dealer.

windows
When opening or closing the side windows, particularly in automatic mode, body parts can become
trapped between the moving side window and stationary vehicle parts.
e
When opening and closing the side windows,
make sure that no parts of the body can become
trapped between the moving side windows and
stationary vehicle parts.
e

when leaving the vehicle. People who are unfamiliar with the vehicle could be injured when
operating the power windows.
e
In case of danger: Release the button on the vehicle key immediately.

Do not leave children unattended in the vehicle.

### General Safety Notices
`porsche_taycan_en_7f61795b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:270
WARNING
Electric shock, short circuit, fire or explosion

### Touching conductive parts of the vehicle can give
`porsche_taycan_en_d6ff55e9` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:270
you an electric shock. You can cause a short circuit
when working on the vehicle's electrical system. The
short circuit can cause a fire.
e

### Work on the electrical system and removing and
`porsche_taycan_en_2cc0744b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:270
installing the 12 V lithium battery must only be
carried out by an authorized Porsche dealer.

### Escaping electrolyte fluid
`porsche_taycan_en_a003d97d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:270
and toxic gas
If the 12 volt lithium battery is damaged or handled
incorrectly, there is the risk in rare cases that electrolyte fluid or toxic gases could escape from it.
e
Avoid any inhalation of the vapors and any skin
contact with the electrolyte fluid.
e
Keep people away and on the side facing into the
wind.
e
Only charge the 12 V lithium battery in well
ventilated spaces.
WARNING

### Supplying external power using unsuitable jumper
`porsche_taycan_en_96b652a3` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:270
cables or following incorrect procedures can cause
short circuits. The short circuit can cause a fire.
e

### Follow instructions of the jumper cable
`porsche_taycan_en_1f40a152` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:270
manufacturer.
e
The vehicles must not touch, otherwise current
may flow as soon as the positive terminals are
connected.
e
Ensure that conductive jewelry (e.g. rings,
chains, watch straps) do not come into contact
with live parts of the vehicle.
e
Never connect jumper cables directly to the 12 V
lithium battery or other electrical components.

### When emergency starting a frozen or damaged bat-
`porsche_taycan_en_60181097` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:270
tery, there is a danger of explosion and chemical
burns.
e

### The use of boosters or non-approved chargers can
`porsche_taycan_en_b73cd881` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:270
result in the battery being charged with excessive
charging voltage and excessive charging current.
This can damage the battery and irritating gases can
escape. This can cause considerable damage to the
vehicle and burns.
e
Do not use boosters.
e

### Only use chargers that have been approved by
`porsche_taycan_en_18a6a941` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:270
the equipment manufacturer for LiFePO4 batteries with integrated electronic protection
circuits.
e

### The following maximum values must never be
`porsche_taycan_en_03a5ddc8` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:270
exceeded:
–
Max. charging voltage: 14.8 V (even in the
event of a fault with battery disconnected; no
voltage peaks permitted)
–

### Max. charging current: 90 A
`porsche_taycan_en_f2b91eb5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:270
e
If in doubt, contact an authorized Porsche dealer.
NOTICE

### Exhaustively discharged
`porsche_taycan_en_08e3ae87` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:270
12 V lithium battery
Risk of damage when supplying external power to an
exhaustively discharged 12 V lithium battery.
e
If you suspect that the 12 V lithium battery is
exhaustively discharged, do not supply power
from an external source.
NOTICE

### Electrical control units and components pose a risk
`porsche_taycan_en_be54b0c2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:270
of short circuits, fire, and damage.
e Removing and installing the battery must only be
carried out by an authorized Porsche dealer.

### Porsche recommends an authorized Porsche
`porsche_taycan_en_37fd53b2` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:270
dealer, as they have trained technicians and the
necessary parts and tools.
e

The 12 V lithium battery is housed in the back of the
trunk under a plastic cover.

### The 12-volt lithium battery is automatically discon-
`porsche_taycan_en_1dc9b154` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
nected from the vehicle electrical system if the battery charge state is low. When the 12-volt lithium
battery is discharged, it is impossible to operate the
vehicle. The electrical system is deactivated
temporarily.
e
Observe the warning message.

### Charging the 12-volt lithium battery:
`porsche_taycan_en_29e410df` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
e
Establish driving readiness.
>
Please see chapter "Starting, driving and
stopping the vehicle" on page 216.
– or –
e

### Then establish operational readiness or charge
`porsche_taycan_en_92e22061` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
the 12-volt battery using the charger.
After establishing operational readiness, charging
the 12-volt lithium battery with a charger (for at
least 10 minutes) or supplying electricity from an
external source, the electrical system is automatically reactivated. The 12-volt lithium battery is automatically re-connected to the vehicle electrical
supply.
Using a jumper cable, the battery of another vehicle
can be used to supply electricity to the vehicle. Both
batteries must have a nominal voltage level of 12
volts. The capacity (Ah) of the donor battery must
not be substantially less than that of the discharged
battery. The discharged 12-volt lithium battery
must be connected properly to the vehicle electrical
system.

### The need to repeatedly supply electricity from an
`porsche_taycan_en_44bd1737` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
external source or charge the 12-volt lithium battery
under normal operating conditions may indicate that
the 12-volt lithium battery is damaged.

### Wear protective goggles

Fire, sparks, naked flames and smoking
are prohibited

### Risk of chemical burns

Electrolyte fluid is highly corrosive: wear
safety gloves and eye protection.

### First aid
`porsche_taycan_en_1b104df4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:271
If electrolyte fluid splashes into your eye,
rinse immediately for a few minutes with
clean water. Immediately seek medical
attention from a doctor. If electrolyte
fluid splashes onto your skin or clothing,
neutralize immediately with soapsuds
and rinse with plenty of water. If you accidentally drink electrolyte fluid, consult
a doctor immediately.

### Never attempt to replace the 12 volt
`porsche_taycan_en_e402ed50` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
lithium battery on your own. The 12 V
lithium battery of this vehicle is only to
be replaced with a 12 V lithium battery
explicitly provided for this vehicle by
Porsche. The use of other 12 V lithium or
lead batteries will cause significant disruptions to or even the total failure of the
electrical system.

### Replacing the 12 V lithium battery is
`porsche_taycan_en_6ab8dfad` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:271
only to be carried out by a qualified specialist repair shop. Porsche recommends
an authorized Porsche dealer, as they
have trained technicians and the necessary parts and tools.

### In addition to significant malfunctions of the vehicle
`porsche_taycan_en_60c7c5b5` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:273
electrical system, use of an unsuitable 12 V lithium
battery or its incorrect installation may in exceptional cases cause a fire (e.g. during charging).
e
Never attempt to replace the 12 V lithium battery yourself. Only have the 12 V lithium battery
of this vehicle replaced with a 12 V lithium battery explicitly specified by Porsche for this vehicle. The use of other lithium or lead-acid
batteries results in significant malfunctions including total failure of the electrical system.
e
Always have the 12 V lithium battery replaced by
a qualified specialist repair shop. Porsche recommends an authorized Porsche dealer, as they
have trained technicians and the necessary parts
and tools.
e

On the following pages you will find technical data
for your vehicle.

### Fig. 215: Location of the vehicle identification number
`porsche_taycan_en_1b30310d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:276
The vehicle identification number is located behind
the windshield at the bottom left as well as underneath the passenger seat.
e
When ordering spare parts, always specify the
vehicle identification number.

### The safety compliance sticker is your assurance that
`porsche_taycan_en_00e64288` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:276
your new Porsche complies with all applicable Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards that were in effect at the time the vehicle was manufactured.
The sticker also shows the month and year of production and the vehicle identification number of your
car (perforations) as well as the Gross Vehicle
Weight Rating and the Gross Axle Weight Rating.

### Tire pressure plate
`porsche_taycan_en_00196f38` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:276
Fig. 217: Location of the tire pressure plate
The tire pressure plate is located on the door sill at
the driver's door.

### Vehicle data carrier
`porsche_taycan_en_44b840ab` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:276
You will find the vehicle data carrier in the Maintenance booklet. It contains all important data about
your vehicle. This data carrier cannot be reordered if
it is lost or damaged.

### Loading Information
`porsche_taycan_en_a0898615` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:safety | p:276
Definitions
The rear-axle load is the vehicle weight on the rear
axle plus the weight of the transported load.
The Curb weight – actual weight of your vehicle – is
the vehicle weight including standard and optional
equipment, fluids, and emergency tools. This weight
does not include passengers and cargo.
The Gross Vehicle Weight is the sum of the curb
weight and the weight of passengers and cargo
combined.

### The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating is the maximum
`porsche_taycan_en_fbbba4d4` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:body | p:276
total weight of vehicle, passengers, luggage and optional equipment.
The Gross Axle Weight Rating is the maximum load
limit for the front or the rear axle. This information is
located on the safety compliance sticker located in
the driver’s side door aperture area.

### Technical Data
`porsche_taycan_en_34ae756b` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
275
For determining the compatibility of the tire and vehicle load capabilities:
>

page 252.
The load capacity coefficient (e.g. “106”) is a minimum requirement. For more information:
>

### The Gross Combined Weight Rating is the maximum
`porsche_taycan_en_3d0fc883` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
total weight rating of vehicle, passengers and cargo.
The Vehicle Capacity Weight – Load Limit – is the
maximum total weight limit specified of the load
(passengers and cargo) for the vehicle. This is the
maximum weight of passengers and cargo that can
be loaded into the vehicle. This information can be
found on the tire pressure plate.
The maximum loaded vehicle weight is the sum of
curb weight, accessory weight, vehicle capacity
weight and production options weight.
The load rating is the maximum load that a tire is
rated to carry for a given inflation pressure.
The maximum load rating is the load rating for a tire
at the maximum permissible inflation pressure.
The cargo capacity is the permissible weight of cargo, the subtracted weight of passengers from the
load limit.
e
Never exceed the permissible limits.
DANGER

### Riding in a Cargo Area
`porsche_taycan_en_eb996edb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
Injuries are much more likely in an accident if occupants ride in the cargo area.
e

### Overloading Vehicle
`porsche_taycan_en_5065f21d` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
Overloading will lead to dangerous vehicle reactions
and long braking distances.
e
Never exceed the specified axle loads.
NOTICE
Risk of damage to the vehicle if the vehicle is
overloaded.
Overloading can shorten the service life of the tires
and car. Damage due to overloading is not covered
by the vehicle warranty.
e
Never exceed the specified axle loads.

### Steps for determining correct load limit:
`porsche_taycan_en_bb9c7ede` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
1. Locate the statement “The combined weight of
occupants and cargo should never exceed XXX kg
or XXX lbs.” on your vehicle’s placard.

### 4. The resulting figure equals the available amount
`porsche_taycan_en_a3f36e8f` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
of cargo and luggage load capacity. For example,
if the “XXX” amount equals 1400 lbs. and there
will be four 150 lb passengers in your vehicle,
the amount of available cargo and luggage load
capacity is 650 lbs. [1400 – 600 (4 x 150) =
800 lbs.].

### 5. Determine the combined weight of luggage and
`porsche_taycan_en_2c43e8e1` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:general | p:277
cargo being loaded on the vehicle. That weight
may not safely exceed the available cargo and
luggage load capacity calculated in Step 4.

### Wheels and Tires
`porsche_taycan_en_72e831cb` | taycan | owners_manual | tier:3 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:281
Wheel and tire sizes
The load capacity code number (e.g. "105") and speed code letter for permitted maximum speed (e.g. "Y") are minimum requirements. When fitting new or different
tires:
>
Please see chapter "Wheels and Tires" on page 252.
e
Snow chains must only be fitted to the appropriately marked wheel and tire sizes. Observe the applicable national regulations regarding maximum speeds when
snow chains are fitted. Only use snow chains approved by Porsche.
e
Before fitting different wheels and tires, check the EU declaration of conformity to see if the desired wheel/tire combination is permitted for your vehicle. For
more information: Contact an authorized Porsche dealer.
